description: Read one model or API selected from search_apis. For an API, returns the exact input_schema, public examples, pricing and api_version. For a model, returns the chat completions input shape, model_id, and catalog pricing when the model catalog provides it. Read this before executing. Discovery does not run a paid call, and displayed pricing is not a price lock. Call run_api only after the user confirms this live price. Discovery and price checks are free; execution needs an OpenAny API key. Eligible Agent newcomers automatically receive $0.10 in credit.
name: get_api
title: Get API or model details
